title: Worker offers
canonical_definition: Advertise hardware/software capacity, availability, jurisdiction and price.
purpose: Extend the qualified fixed-price ComputeOfferRegistry420 into the canonical worker-market offer surface without implementing requests or matching.
requirements: hardware profile commitment advertised from canonical resource
software/runtime and capability commitments advertised from canonical resource
capacity units advertised from canonical resource
immutable offer identity with monotonic revisions
resource/provider revision drift invalidates future effectiveness
direct canonical operator compatibility retained for legacy fixed-price publish
cancellation is terminal and cannot resurrect an offer
no request, match, reservation, settlement or scheduler authority introduced

authority.direct_operator: canonical node operator under active provider

invariants: offer terms cannot outlive or override canonical provider/node/resource ancestry
offer effectiveness fails closed on resource/provider revision drift
price and capacity are positive and bounded by versioned offer terms
future availability cannot be treated as currently effective
cancelled offers cannot be updated or resurrected
delegated authority is exact-resource scoped and amount bounded

required: directly applicable Compute Market and Solidity-fast CI
qualification.level_2_rationale: Worker offers are the first CMP-2 market-side component. Broader matching integration is deferred until requests and matching converge.

intentionally_deferred: CMP-2.4 pricing model beyond fixed-price worker offers
exit_criteria: worker offer exposes canonical hardware/software/capability/capacity snapshot
worker offer exposes availability, jurisdiction and price
publish/update/cancel authority is fail-closed and exact-resource scoped
offer history is reconstructable and immutable
SDK validates the same public worker-offer schema
durable evidence records the exact qualified implementation SHA
